0.name: Actinic Keratoses and Intraepithelial Carcinoma
0.description: Pre-cancerous lesions that may develop into squamous cell carcinoma.

1.name: Basal Cell Carcinoma
1.description: Most common type of skin cancer, rarely metastasizes.

2.name: Benign Keratosis
2.description: Includes seborrheic keratoses, solar lentigo, and lichen planus-like keratoses.

3.name: Dermatofibroma
3.description: Common benign skin nodule of unknown etiology.

4.name: Melanoma
4.description: Most dangerous form of skin cancer, develops from melanocytes.

6.name: Vascular Lesions
6.description: Includes angiomas, angiokeratomas, pyogenic granulomas, and hemorrhage.
